chunk_measurements.clock: seconds from t_origin, from time.monotonic(); monotonic, same process, not wall-clock and not comparable across machines
chunk_measurements.gap_population: all adjacent timestamped events, including metadata and completion events
chunk_measurements.note: CHUNK measurements, not time to first token. Session-relative arrivals are not request latency. Missing request starts cannot be recovered; inter_event_gaps_s are gaps between network events, not inter-token latencies.
chunk_measurements.request_latency_limitation: No per-request start timestamps were retained. True first-text latency is unavailable.

evidence_in_this_bundle: INFO:     Uvicorn running on socket ('0.0.0.0', 57237) (Press CTRL+C to quit)
corrections.exposure: for the ~49 s of the session plus startup the port was reachable on every interface of a shared node; the port is closed and the process group is confirmed gone
corrections.fix: zerodiag/stream_runner.listening_bind_addresses() now MEASURES the bind address from /proc/net/tcp at readiness and records it, instead of asserting loopback; the unconditional claim is gone
corrections.installed_cause: vllm/entrypoints/openai/api_server.py:543-544 creates its own socket and calls sock.bind(("", args.port)); an empty host means 0.0.0.0, so --host 127.0.0.1 does not restrict the listener in vllm 0.6.3.post1
corrections.measured_truth: the listener was bound to 0.0.0.0 (all interfaces)
corrections.status: WRONG as recorded: it was an assertion, not a measurement
corrections.what_is_still_true: every accepted connection came from 127.0.0.1: the access log in server.stdout holds 101 request lines (1 GET /health and 100 POST /v1/completions), all with peer 127.0.0.1 and all status 200, so the client's requests reached this newly launched server and no foreign client was served

corrections.fix: stated here and in the report; the key is left as recorded
corrections.meaning: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() inside the RUNNER (client) process, which never allocates on the device: generation happens in the separate server process. It is 0.0 and it is NOT the server's device memory, which this session did not measure

corrections.consequence: the aggregate host RSS including the server was NOT measured for this session. No breach was observed in what was monitored, and the 32 GiB budget was not approached by the monitored group, but the aggregate figure is unavailable and is not claimed
corrections.fix: recorded as a limitation; the server's process group membership and its confirmed shutdown ARE retained in server_shutdown.members_before / members_after
corrections.meaning: the monitor attributes RSS by the runner's own process group (pgid). The server is deliberately started with start_new_session=True so its whole group can be signalled and confirmed gone, which puts it in a DIFFERENT process group, outside this monitor's attribution. The figure is the client/runner group only
corrections.status: correct for what it measures, narrower than the window's limit

corrections.reason: One t_origin was created for the whole session; no per-request start timestamps were retained.
corrections.status: WITHDRAWN as latency; session-relative event arrivals only
